name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc25): an approval map can be changed instead of rebuilt. Until now its shape and its amount limits were fixed once it was created, so raising a threshold or adding an approval tier meant deleting the whole map and starting again. You can now change the amount bands on a rule, add a step with its approver, or remove a step - and removing a step correctly takes its approvers with it. Two of these reorder things behind the scenes so the result is what you asked for: a new step really does end up last, and a rule is never briefly left with no limit at all, which would have meant every document routing through that approver. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
